Name: New recipes - Tiny Fruit Buns
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][i][center][b]~ Cute Fruit Buns ~[/b][/center][/i]
[/size][size=4][center]Six new recipes~[/center][/size]

This is just a simple mod that adds six recipes to the game to make some buns!
This is my first recipes mod but I plan on making some more!

Open to suggestions~~

If there's any bun you don't want, simply delete the folder!
To cook[b][u] five[/u][/b] buns, you'll nade three pieces of one of these fruits: cherry, banana, apple, peach, blueberry or strawberry.
And, one of flour, sugar and milk!

[size=5][i][b][center]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/center][/b]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
